text:
- [LLOG.11.5] **Negation under `logical` is supported** with
  absence-justified semantics.

idris.name: iret_7_8__activation_live
idris.note: Absence-justified semantics: a `no` pattern broken ends the activation and withdraws what it justified; released again, the token fires and justifies afresh.

idris.name: iret_7_8__activation_live_net
idris.note: Negation under `logical` on the network: a match a `no` pattern now blocks has left its terminal, so its activation has ended and its justifications go -- absence-justified.
